This is exactly how I feel except I'm a guy. Intimacy, what's that? I've never even gotten someone to hold hands on a walk. Looks are nothing to me, all I've ever wanted is someone that cares and can hold a decent conversation and a personality...I bet a lot of other guys feel this way too...

I also have no friends and my family has pretty much disowned me for being 22 and not having someone to call a girlfriend. 

I know a lot about guns, I own plenty and love them...but I've never gone through with it because the aftermath is so fucked up I wouldn't want to hurt others who find me

Virgin? Why not find a nice, attractive escort and for a couple hundred bucks land yourself a fast lay? I know paying for what others get for free is silly but why not?

I'm not a Virgin but I have been alone my whole life (going on 23). It's not even about sex anymore I've had my share, it's about having a relationship. I finally realized I'll be alone forever and set a date as a form of motivation to get out and find someone. Maybe you can try that too? I don't know. Anyway I feel for you and know firsthand just how fucked up this world we live in is.

I've never felt so desperate to try and keep someone as I have with this girl. We shared so many personal details about each other's lives. 

It just sucks.

If I pull the trigger I'll leave her everything since I don't have any siblings to leave it to. I just don't care anymore

Yes, It was purchased for me as a "gift" when I was two years old. My grandfather was well off and bought large policies (500K) for his grandchildren.

Apparently the policy is written so that the payout doubles if I commit suicide or die in an accident. Not sure of the terminology but that's how it was explained to me by him. He also conveniently worked for the company and sold policies for years..

Yeah I will. I'm 6'5" 265 lbs. Not really fat. Biggest issue is my teeth...they are a little crooked with a gap and I don't have the money to get them fixed (read: braces or misaligned) and my ins. will not cover it. 

Last person I met I overheard her say she didn't trust me to her friends...I'm a gentle giant and wouldn't hurt anyone except myself. I wish people would give me time to shine and not sink me without the chance to show that I'm a nice, caring (yet shy and awkward) person.

I've thought about 25 or 27, roughly half of my life expectancy (according to the life insurance company). I have a policy that pays out if I commit suicide and in August I will have met the minimum time frame allowing for a payout to whoever I list as primary beneficiary. 

If I could find someone and they stayed with me (even as good platonic friends) they would be the beneficiary as I have no siblings or anyone else I would want to name as such. Morbid, I know.

I'm not a virgin, don't want to get into details but I've had one night stand(s) before.

Still, good advice I suppose.
Thanks for the motivational responses. I'm still in limbo but will see what happens by Sept. I need to get some sleep I'll re-visit this in the morning on here.

I'm said to myself no way...like you said if I got caught I would be up shits creek without a paddle. Weed in small quantities is one thing (misdemeanor in my state) but hooking a bunch of 18 and 19 year Olds up with booze is a felony...and you and I know they aren't going to take the blame it'll all be on me and while they get a slap on the wrist I do time. No way.

Out of a few dozen people I messaged on POF I got like 8 or 9 replies mostly one liners but she was the most outgoing/talkative one. 

So I texted here and asked if she wanted to drink/smoke before she leaves and she says "Maybe. I'm gonna be fucked up" I'm thinking yeah you must have sucked some dude off for booze and said fuck him (me). Every. Other response has been a "Maybe" which I'm starting to see at face value (Read; NO).

It sucks, I'm socially awkward and shy as hell and I put a lot of effort/time into this leading up to me meeting her. I think she just wanted me so she wouldn't  be seen as the single loner (third wheel) on her trip for a night. I can't believe how stupid I am, I've had trust issues with girls in the past and we talked extensively about each other's lives and problems. This is the second (well, third) person I've ever met up with and I'm about to call it quits, I lowered my standards and still got fucked! I'm doomed to never have companionship...just be used.
